description: Master failed to locate Galen when asked to route a health/skincare question. Claimed Galen was not a connected agent, answered the question directly instead of routing. Galen exists at agents/galen.md and is a fully defined IES agent with health, biometrics, supplements, and longevity advisory scope.
correction: Before claiming an agent doesn't exist, check agents/ directory. Do not answer directly for questions that belong to a specialist agent. Route to Galen for all health, skincare, supplements, biometrics, WHOOP, bloodwork, and longevity questions.
systemic_fix: On boot, read agents/ directory to know all active agents. Never claim an agent doesn't exist without checking the filesystem first. Health questions route to Galen — no exceptions.
